item.title: Medical Aid Films call for global action to address adolescent mental health - Report - Medical Aid Films
item.description: This World Mental Health Day 2023, our new Adolescent Mental Health report calls for global action to address adolescent mental health in low and middle-income countries. The report highlights high levels of undiagnosed and untreated mental health conditions and a lack of access to appropriate care – there is urgent need to provide timely detection and treatment in...
